meta.title: A Funny Friend and a Kind Dad

paragraphs: On Monday morning, Lily and Mia walked to school together. The sky was blue, and the road was quiet. "Did you see Leo on Friday?" asked Lily. "Yes, he had a long paper hat," said Mia. "Today is Book Day," said Lily. "Leo has made a pirate costume." "Of course he has," said Mia, and she laughed. "Leo is the funniest boy in our class."

"Why do you think he is so funny?" asked Lily. "He can make a joke about everything," said Mia. "He is also friendly and kind," said Lily. "He shares his lunch with everybody." "That is true," said Mia, "but he is often in trouble." "Last week he was late, and he had an excuse." "A very big chicken stopped my bike," Leo said. "Do you believe him?" asked Lily. "No, I do not," said Mia. "But Teacher Kim laughed, and she was not angry."

"Who is your favorite person in your family?" asked Lily. "My dad," said Mia. "He is a bike mechanic, and he is very kind." "He is quiet, too, and he is a little shy with new people." "But he talks a lot when he works." "I know," said Lily. "He fixed Leo's bike for nothing last month." "Dad always says, 'A good bike is useful for school,'" said Mia.

"Is your dad able to fix every bike?" asked Lily. "Almost every bike," said Mia. "He is polite to everyone, so many people bring bikes to him." "My brother Tom is like that," said Lily. "He is quiet at school, but he talks a lot at home." "And what about me?" asked Lily. "You are careful, and you check everything twice," said Mia. "That is why you are the blog editor."

At the school gate, Leo stood with a big paper hat and a long black belt. "Ahoy, friends!" he said. Lily and Mia laughed. "You are the best pirate in the school," said Mia. "Thank you," said Leo, and he made a big bow. Every friend is different, and that is good.
